question: Freeze last@20 reporting protocol and reaggregate A2 multiseed without unconditional retrain?
reason: J3b/J4 justify freezing primary=last@20 to avoid best-on-val spike allergy. Existing Gate I runs already have last.pt and epoch-20 logged evals, so reaggregation needs no full retrain. However last@20 three-seed range remains large (~0.060) and seed44 stays low at the fixed endpoint, so formal baseline freeze / A4-P01 unblock is not justified yet.
next_direction: Diagnose why fixed-endpoint last@20 still spreads (especially seed43 collapse from best and seed44 low). Candidate levers: data scale, LR/warmup, epoch budget. Keep method comparisons blocked until noise << expected gain under v2.
